messages.methodology.source.title: Where do the prices come from?
messages.methodology.source.body: ANP, Brazil’s oil and fuels regulator, publishes the price survey. Abastevo organizes the observations by product, unit and area. Enforcement records and community-reported prices are separate sources.
messages.methodology.sample.title: How should I read the figures?
messages.methodology.sample.body: Each summary uses the latest valid price per station for the fuel and unit. The sample mean is the sum divided by the number of stations with a price. Small samples limit which figures appear. A missing survey leaves a gap in the data.
messages.methodology.revisions.title: Why might figures change?
messages.methodology.revisions.body: The dates apply to the survey shown. When ANP corrects a survey, the portal publishes the latest revision. Changes are calculated only when both surveys sample the same stations. Prices are updated with the survey.
messages.methodology.privacy.title: What is excluded from the data?
messages.methodology.privacy.body: The public files exclude personal tax IDs (CPF), user photos, contributor locations and internal documents.
messages.data.csv: CSV files use UTF-8. Fields beginning with =, +, - or @ are prefixed with an apostrophe.

messages.methodology.lead: The portal uses dated ANP observations and registries to calculate price summaries.
messages.methodology.dates.title: Source and publication dates
messages.methodology.dates.body: Collection dates apply to individual observations. The period identifies the survey. The publication date identifies the portal snapshot.
messages.methodology.mean.title: Sample mean and comparisons across surveys
messages.methodology.mean.body: The arithmetic mean uses the latest price per station and requires at least five stations. We calculate changes when both surveys cover the same stations. When the sample changes, we show both surveys side by side.
messages.methodology.calculations.title: Official data and Abastevo calculations
messages.methodology.calculations.body: ANP supplies the observations. Abastevo calculates the minimum, maximum, spread, mean and rankings from each area’s sample without averaging municipal means.
messages.methodology.limits.title: Publication conditions
messages.methodology.limits.body: Publication depends on data rights and the monetary precision policy for prices with more than three decimal places. Enforcement records require an official data feed and a verified station association.

messages.insights.official.scope.title: What do the published enforcement records cover?
messages.insights.official.scope.detail: The records reflect the annual edition as of the source extraction date. Later records require a new revision.

messages.insights.official.link.detail: The revision records an association based on the full CNPJ and the applicable registry. The link cannot establish historical operation of the site.
